locator: Original Table 7, p. 67, resting squid giant axon, solutions B, C and E
mapping: Each value is the change on replacing the baseline bath by the test bath. The sign is converted from the original outside-minus-inside convention to inside-minus-outside. Table 7 gives mean shifts rounded to mV without row-specific errors or temperatures. We use the 21 °C mean from Table 3. The authors used prior axoplasm assays and chose the resting permeability ratios against their observations on p. 68. Only relative permeabilities enter the reversal.
